messages:
ajay: deploy-bot preflight flagged a failure for myservice chart. values reference old KMS alias after recent secret rotation. canary paused automatically — need decision: pin to 2.3.9 or abort rollout and push hotfix?

deploy-bot: PRECHECK FAILED:
  resource: secret 'svc-db-key'
  chart: myservice@2.4.0
  details: values.database.secretKeyRef -> alias 'projects/redwood/keys/svc-db-key-v1' not readable
  action: canary paused, rollout halted

maria: ack. ops did a key rotation on friday night, was supposed to keep alias but looks like it removed the old alias entirely.

kevin: confirmed. new key alias svc-db-key-v2 exists. app still expects v1 alias. fallback not available currently.

sophie: if canary is paused and we have queued releases, pinning to the previous chart sounds fastest. hotfix is better long-term but will delay everything. change window?

ajay: change window ends in ~45m. options: 1) pin to 2.3.9 and resume canary now, 2) abort and push hotfix that uses v2 alias, 3) patch values to fallback alias (risky).

kevin: hotfix estimate ~25-35m to build/test/canary. pin is ~5m. my vote = hotfix if we can afford the delay, else pin.

sophie: +1 pin to unblock dependent teams. we'll follow with hotfix. add to release notes.

maria: +1 for pin. I'll open a postmortem to track alias management.

ajay: voting: kevin prefers hotfix but team leaning pin. decision: pin for immediate unblock, follow-up hotfix scheduled.

deploy-bot: manual override requested. To annotate release, run: 
```
/deploy annotate myservice release deploybot.pin=2.3.9
```
Once annotated, canary will resume with pinned chart.

ajay: running the annotation now:
```
/deploy annotate myservice release deploybot.pin=2.3.9
```

deploy-bot: ACK: annotation applied. canary unpaused. current active chart now 2.3.9 for this rollout.

maria: filing follow-up ticket INF-998 to add alias fallback and verify rotation docs: https://rwd.atlassian/browse/INF-998

kevin: i'll implement secret-resolution unit test and target a patch branch for 2.4.x hotfix. estimate PR by EOD.

sophie: adding release notes line: 'Pinned myservice to 2.3.9 during KMS key rotation; hotfix to follow.'

oncall-bot: reminder: change window ends at 2859995733 UTC. escalation policy will trigger +30m after window close.

ajay: thanks all — keeping this thread for audit. :thumbsup:
